messages:
Ravi: Quick check-in on the model catalog compare table — the table feels cramped on laptop widths when filters are open. Primary read column (accuracy/latency) scrolls out of view.
Ana: Saw that in the research lab. Two ideas: make the compare pane sticky or collapse the left filter rail by default on compare mode.
Clara: Sticky helps but introduces overlap with the compare header. If we sticky we need a smaller header height and a clear z-index plan.
Noah: Another angle: let users pin a metric column (like latency) so it stays visible while filters are toggled. Could be a per-user preference.
Diego: Performance badges are taking lots of visual space. Proposal: normalize to a simple dot + short label (dot color = good/warn/bad) and on hover expand a mini-popover with full metric names.
Ravi: Love the dot idea for scan. But accessibility: color-only cues need text equivalents. Ensure aria-describedby on the dot and a visible label on focus.
Ana: For small screens we should hide secondary badges and show a single summary badge with ">1 metric" affordance that expands inline. Similar to mobile chip overflow.
Clara: Pinning UX confusion: users expected "pin" to scope to the current search. Currently it persists globally. Recommend adding a small toast "Pinned version globally" with an action to "Apply to current search only".
Noah: Also add a subtle header banner that says "Pinned: v3.2.1" which links to explanation. That helps discoverability when filters change.
Diego: Microcopy: change table action from "Pin" to "Pin version (global)" and add a secondary option in the menu for "Pin to current filters".
Ravi: Keyboard flow issue: when expanding the +n badge overflow the focus lands on the close button first. Should focus the first metric in the list.
Ana: Tooltip timing: current hover tooltips appear instantly and feel flickery when moving across badges. Add a short 200ms delay on show and no delay on hide.
Clara: Suggested CSS snippet for compact badges:
```css
.badge--compact{ width:20px; height:20px; padding:6px; border-radius:4px; }
.badge--compact .hit-target{ display:inline-block; padding:6px; margin:-6px; }
```
Noah: Engineering note: keep hit target >=32px for touch even if visual is 20px. Use negative margin technique like above.
Diego: QA note: when filter groups switch we lost the pinned row highlight in the staging build — file a bug.
Ravi: Figma frames incoming for three variants: sticky left, compact badges + overflow, and pin-banner + per-filter pin.
DesignBot: Reminder: add localization keys for all badge labels and banner copy.
Ana: I can prototype the compact + overflow pattern today. Assigning myself.
Clara: I'll draft the a11y acceptance (contrast ratios, aria labels, keyboard order, focus management).
Noah: I'll prototype the per-user pin preference toggle in the settings mock.
Diego: I'll file the bug and add tests for pinned highlight persistence.
Ravi: Thanks. Let's review the Figma frames Thurs 11am — please bring a short screen recording of the overflow interaction.
